title: AI-powered ECG model detects acute coronary occlusion myocardial infarction
summary: A model developed on 18,616 ECGs from 10,543 patients with suspected acute coronary syndrome was evaluated on an international test cohort of 3,254 ECGs. It reached an AUC of 0.938, accuracy 90.9%, sensitivity 80.6% and specificity 93.7%, versus 83.6% accuracy for STEMI criteria. The evaluation is retrospective.
ai_technology: Deep learning model on single 12-lead ECGs
organization: University of Naples Federico II; OLV Hospital Aalst; Powerful Medical

evidence.tested: Detection of acute coronary occlusion MI in an international test cohort compared with STEMI criteria and ECG experts.
